login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Enter your credentials to access your account

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.subtitle: Set a new password to continue.
changePassword.hint: At least 8 characters, including a letter and a number.

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.description: You do not have sufficient permissions to view this section. If you believe this is a mistake, please contact your administrator.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.description: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again or contact your administrator.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: This address does not exist or has been moved.

dashboard.intro: This is the school CRM dashboard. Modules are being added step by step.
dashboard.moduleComingSoon: This module will be launched in the next phases.

students.title: Students
students.subtitle: Student directory — search and filter within your access scope.
students.filtersHint: Search by name, status, or class.
students.name: Name

teachers.title: Teachers
teachers.subtitle: Teacher directory — account, subjects, and homeroom duties.
teachers.filtersHint: Search by name, email, phone, subject, or status.
teachers.loginHint: Email or phone — at least one is required and is used as the login.
teachers.passwordHint: At least 8 characters with a letter and a number. The teacher changes it on first sign-in.
teachers.passwordEditHint: Passwords are not changed here — the teacher changes it personally.
teachers.mustChangePassword: This teacher has not changed the initial password yet.

subjects.title: Subjects
subjects.subtitle: The schedule and grades rely on this list.
subjects.formHint: The Uzbek name is required; Russian and English names are optional.
subjects.deleteBlocked: The subject was not deleted because it is used in lessons, grades, or tests.

academicYears.title: Academic years
academicYears.subtitle: Academic years and quarters — classes and grades are tied to them.
academicYears.formHint: Fill in the quarters now and the grades module will be ready.
academicYears.name: Name
academicYears.quartersHint: Quarters with both dates are saved. Quarters are never deleted — only updated.
academicYears.isCurrentHint: This is the current academic year (only one can be current)
academicYears.deleteBlocked: The academic year was not deleted because classes or grades are linked to it.

lessonPeriods.title: Bell schedule
lessonPeriods.subtitle: Lesson time slots. The timetable is built on top of these slots.
lessonPeriods.formHint: Time slots must not overlap and the order number must be unique.
lessonPeriods.label: Note
lessonPeriods.deleteBlocked: The time slot was not deleted because lessons are assigned to it.
lessonPeriods.empty: The bell schedule is still empty.

classes.title: Classes
classes.subtitle: Classes, homeroom teachers, and student rosters.
classes.formHint: Two classes cannot share the same name within one academic year.
classes.deleteBlocked: The class was not deleted because it still has students or lessons.
classes.assignFailed: The action failed. Please try again.
classes.filtersHint: Search by name, grade, or academic year.
classes.name: Name
classes.scheduleHint: You edit the timetable in the Schedule section.
classes.scheduleEmpty: No lessons for this class yet.
classes.studentsEmpty: This class has no students yet.
classes.addStudentsHint: Hold Ctrl (or Cmd) to select several. The list shows active students without a class.
classes.noUnassigned: There are no active students without a class.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.subtitle: Weekly timetable — by class or by teacher.
schedule.chooseHint: Pick a class or a teacher to narrow the timetable.
schedule.formHint: Conflicts are checked on the server: teacher, class, and room cannot be double-booked.
schedule.deleteBlocked: The lesson was not deleted because attendance records are attached to it.
schedule.subject: Subject
schedule.noPeriodsHint: First add lesson time slots in the Bell schedule section.
schedule.noSubjects: Add a subject in the Subjects section first.

import.studentsSubtitle: Download the template, fill it in, and upload the file. Review first, then confirm.
import.teachersSubtitle: An account is created for each row. If the password is empty, the system generates a strong one.
import.uploadHint: Do not rename the template columns. The first row is the header, the rest are data rows.
import.limits: Only .xlsx or .xls · max 5 MB · up to 1000 rows per file. Nothing is written to the database during the check.
import.modeUpdate: Update — existing records are overwritten with the file data.
import.name: Name
import.moreRows: {count} more rows — only the first 200 are shown in the table.
import.confirmHint: Rows with errors are not imported — fix them in the file and upload again.
import.noReadyRows: There are no valid rows to import.
import.credentialsTitle: Logins and passwords for new accounts
import.credentialsHint: These passwords are shown only now and cannot be retrieved later. Download them and share them securely. A password change is required on first sign-in.
